reader_summary.overview: Pershing Square Founder & CEO Bill Ackman joins from Tel Aviv to discuss the bull case for investing in Israel and the broader investment landscape. Then, Roundhill CEO Dave Mazza joins to discuss the latest round of tech earnings and where he sees opportunity. Plus, we bring you the details of a new security flaw that was uncovered in the software that runs most of the internet.
